snippet.title: Clean Start - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
In Clean Start, you clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering heartfelt stories through the objects you find. Piece together each room’s narrative, discover hidden secrets, and experience the satisfaction of tidying up spaces in this cozy puzzle game set in a country whose language you don’t fully understand.

It is currently in development for PC platforms with a release date of 2026.

Your wishlist means the world to us—thank you!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3577020/Clean_Start/

For game updates and events, follow us:
